composition: TerminalDeliveryLedger + MixedDeliveryLedger; TerminalRecipientInbox + MixedRecipientInbox; existing fixed-route mTLS and authoritative sender witness
scope: Already-admitted fixed-route count/histogram L3 tickets only, post-expiry result-free reconciliation; no pre-L3 withheld events or cross-route protocol

control.public_descriptor: Original internal action digest/domain/snapshot/accountant/mechanism/N/B/K/codec/catalog/digest/ordered public labels; matches MixedDelivery descriptor
control.bindings: deployment, tenant, recipient, gateway, session, sender/receiver certificate, delivery/operation, sequence and original lifetime
control.envelope_hash: empty iff no prepared envelope, otherwise SHA256 of exact signed envelope; not a bare plaintext result hash
control.forbidden: No result or result envelope field; unprepared control construction reads public operation metadata without opening seed/result
control.validation: Closed fields; independent MixedDeliveryTerminal signature domain; exact original ticket/shape/hash binding; shape validation reuses descriptor validation without synthetic result

protocol.sender: Only earliest unfinished route sequence after original expiry; immutable encrypted control and receipt in witnessed state; no new L3, lifetime extension, sample, fee or refund
protocol.recipient: BEGIN IMMEDIATE shares the lock with ordinary acceptance. Existing exact inbox returns ACCEPTED with original accepted_at; otherwise persist CLOSED tombstone and first closed_at; never infer CLOSED from absence alone
protocol.barrier: CLOSED fences any later envelope matching delivery ID or sequence, including a re-signed future lifetime; receipt commits before reply
protocol.ack_consistency: Ordinary ACK accepted_at equals terminal ACCEPTED event_at in either arrival order and audit; conflicting signed outcome or time is rejected
protocol.retry: Fresh challenge/request hash, identical control, unchanged first event time; missing response can be retried; W-accepted/local-lost state recovered without re-query
protocol.continuation: Only confirmed ACKED/CLOSED sequence can be skipped for later route work

verification.pipeline: B4 N3 full mixed signed/encrypted/witnessed fixture; expired unsent histogram closure then count delivery with unchanged all-ancestor accounts
verification.B64_scope: 64 maximal public labels wire-only terminal descriptor and CLOSED inbox fixture, not full 64-bucket execution/performance
verification.races: Acceptance wins and closure wins; each serializes at recipient write transaction
verification.negative_control: Whole recipient store rollback changes first closure time from 160 to 170; sender rejects conflicting evidence but cannot restore recipient or prove nonrollback

remaining: Production receiver authority nonrollback/cross-host recovery and bounded retention; conditional local recovery implemented in TLSWitnessedMixedRecipientInbox
